_comment: The numbers every harvest sprite is rendered and placed by. studio.py builds the camera from this and refuses to render if the ground origin does not land on ground_pivot_pixel; harvest_visual_art.gd reads the same pivot (GROUND_ORIGIN_PIXEL_Y = 467). Change it in both places or in neither. The rig comes from the frozen profile .blend that rendered every shipped sprite (catalog_profile_candidate, 3 October); 'legacy' is the original sprite-pack rig, kept for comparison only.

profile._what: world 'soft blue sky', Sun key 1.1 + Area fill 240 + Area rim 180, Standard view at -0.2 EV, Cycles 24 samples; the camera keeps its orientation and is slid in its own plane until the world origin lands on ground_pivot_pixel

legacy._what: build_pack.py's own rig: one warm softbox, AgX, baked radial shadow. Not what the game ships.
